{{Quote|Drink.|The Queen of the Red requests nectar|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The title of '''bowlcarrier''', was a position which consisted of carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Queen of the Red]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Trevik]] became the bowlcarrier, and the reigning [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]] [[Diet/Legends|drank]] from Trevik's bowl several times while speaking with her ally, [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. When the bowlcarrier was kidnapped by [[Unidentified Circling|one]] of the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] [[Circling|advisors]] and ordered to [[Holocamera/Legends|record]] Esva's [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] Trevik refused to cooperate as he was the bowlcarrier. However, he ultimately did as ordered and shared the recordings with his [[Trevik's family|brother]] [[Jirvin]] the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. The next morning, the monarch drank from Trevik's bowl several times until her ally [[Death/Legends|murdered]] her during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between Esva and the Queen's forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The position of bowlcarrier appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
